answer: Locks are recorded in gale, expire in ivory, and raven lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 186 aliases therefore needs 139 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1703 identities would post 2657 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
